summary: This Form 6-K is a routine reminder notice for Nova Minerals Ltd shareholders and listed warrantholders of upcoming scheme meetings on 29 May 2026 to vote on a previously announced scheme of arrangement. The filing provides logistics for in-person and virtual attendance, voting deadlines, and record dates. The board unanimously recommends voting in favor, supported by an independent expert report from RSM Corporate Australia concluding the scheme is in shareholders' best interests. No deal terms, price, or premium are disclosed in this notice. This is a procedural filing, not a new special-situation event.
